item.description: - Highlights shows your highlights again. If ibid was moved to another folder while it was open (from one Applications folder to the other, say), the list and every page in it came up with the words but none of their colours. ibid now keeps everything it needs from the moment it opens. - A page in Highlights now always opens as the whole essay, with your highlights and notes in place. A small tick in each highlight's colour sits beside the scroll bar, at that highlight's place down the page. Click one to go straight to it. - A note holding a long web address now wraps inside its card, rather than running off the edge.
